questions.prompt: Complete a 'none of you truly believes until…' hadith — or name another sign of true faith from the Hadith.

answers.canonical: He loves for his brother what he loves for himself
variants: Love for others what you love for yourself
answers.explanation: "None of you believes until he loves for his brother what he loves for himself."

answers.canonical: The Prophet ﷺ is dearer to him than anyone
answers.explanation: "…until I am more beloved to him than his father, his child and all people."

answers.canonical: His neighbour is safe from his harm
answers.explanation: "By Allah he does not believe… whose neighbour is not safe from his harm."
"Whoever believes in Allah and the Last Day, let him speak good or be silent."

answers.canonical: Muslims are safe from his tongue and hand
answers.explanation: "The Muslim is the one from whose tongue and hand Muslims are safe."
"Love of the Ansar is a sign of faith."

answers.canonical: Happy with good, sad with bad deeds
answers.explanation: "Whoever is pleased by his good deeds and saddened by his bad — that is a believer."
"Whoever loves for Allah and hates for Allah… has completed faith."
"Three things: Allah and His Messenger most beloved, loving a person only for Allah, hating to return to disbelief."
